# gitmoap_group_sso_domains (Data Source)

List the organization's claimed domains and their verification status. In alphabetical order. Only the organization's owners can read it.

The token needs `sso:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_sso_domains" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The organization's top-level group

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `domain` (String)
- `status` (String) Whether a claimed email domain has been verified. A `pending` domain has a DNS challenge to
complete; only a `verified` domain links existing accounts or creates new ones at sign-in.
- `verified_at` (String)
